searches.reason: Develop controlled sequence interventions—recent-history removal, older-history removal, and order shuffling—to measure whether recommendations depend on recent intent and repeated preferences. Use training-only temporal holdouts and matched random interventions to distinguish useful sensitivity from instability, connecting failures to sequence encoding and recency weighting.

searches.reason: Build evidence-based probes for unsupported prerequisites, possible redundant purchases, and specific complementary tasks using only histories, titles, and descriptions. Seek methods that preserve an unknown outcome when compatibility or need cannot be established, and calibrate agreement with the twenty users’ qualitative feedback without inferring unobserved traits or treating uncertainty as rejection.

searches.reason: Replace scale-dependent training margins and mean cosine with trustworthy ranking and representation diagnostics: effective rank, popularity-stratified errors, and rank stability across negative samples. Examine whether these probes predict macro validation HR@10 across four datasets, quantify uncertainty, and identify actionable failures in item embeddings, negative sampling, or the ranking loss while keeping the pinned evaluator unchanged.
